synthetic_signal.applies_to: 173/293 Hz harmonic targets in groups other than nonlinear, fractional_array, aec_methods, aec_subband, spectral_subtraction, clock_drift, interpolation, alignment_error, room_decay, dma_calibration, doa_ambiguity, gsc_gate, aec_dropout, wpe_predictable, css_overlap, agc_blocks, selection_tradeoff and math_block; see each group for noise and transforms

rights: No third-party recordings or model weights. Repository licensing remains unspecified.
pcm: signed little-endian 16-bit, round-to-nearest-even; no dither; no per-file normalization
listening: Start at low device volume. No automatic playback. No formal listening study performed.

parameters.fade: sin(linspace(0,pi/2,320)) squared, endpoint included; reverse at end of active interval
parameters.model: x[n]=s[n]+0.65*x[n-512]; all negative-time samples zero; observation truncated to 32000 samples

stft.istft: squared-window weighted overlap-add, discard initial 256 padding, return first 32000 samples

wpe.statistics: whole-record valid-frame statistics, no temporal power smoothing

parameters.alignment: same sample origin; no fitted delay, no gain correction or separate normalization
parameters.metrics: steady projection gain dot(output,target)/dot(target,target); steady squared error sum((output-target)^2)/sum(target^2); tail mean square includes all samples in declared half-open window
parameters.algorithm_delay_samples: offline noncausal record; no streaming latency claim
parameters.statistics: one deterministic mathematical fixture; no real speech, room or listening study

wpe_predictable.limits: All four mono files share export gain 1. The oracle knows the feedback path; blind WPE does not. The stationary target itself is predictable at the 32 ms delay, so lower tail energy does not guarantee unit target gain. Finite onset/fades and STFT boundary padding affect the fit. No T60, SNR, ERLE or intelligibility claim; tail after the two-second file is excluded. Float and PCM reference scores are reported separately.

parameters.source_model: two deterministic sinusoids; reference stereo is two source tracks, not microphone geometry
parameters.overlap_add: linear complementary weights linspace(0,1,6400), endpoints included
parameters.score_definition: per-stream centered SI-SDR, fixed stream-to-reference order, no PIT or time alignment; PCM scores use PCM references
parameters.alignment_scope: the matcher sees overlapping output waveforms only, never the references; it estimates permutation, not gain/polarity/delay
parameters.failed_overlap_policy: ambiguous returns no mapping; no fabricated identity through silence or ties
parameters.algorithm_latency: offline two-block fixture; matching requires the overlap samples, no measured streaming latency

css_overlap.limits: Given simulated separator slots with residual crosstalk, not actual blind or neural separation. Two sinusoids and a single reliable overlap are not speech, arbitrary-source CSS, or a permanent speaker-identity guarantee. No listening study; stereo channels are output slots, not binaural spatial audio.

agc_blocks.limits: Mathematical 500 Hz tone with intentional envelope steps, no speech or noise. Peak AGC buffers each complete block: samples are available only at its end. Changing alpha with hop preserves its time constant, not block-partition invariance. RMS ratios compare level, not SNR or perceived quality; no listening test claimed.

parameters.coefficient_rule: equal taps divided by their magnitude response at 500 Hz
parameters.convolution: causal linear convolution, zero initial history, retain first 32000 samples
parameters.pcm_fit: joint least squares: DC plus cos/sin at 500,1500,3500 Hz; fit magnitudes
parameters.nmse: output vs same-domain clean delayed by known FIR group delay; no gain fitting

selection_tradeoff.limits: Mathematical three-tone mixture, not speech, ASR or perceived quality. Both filters process the same mixture; separated components are not provided to them. Frequency-specific scoring exploits known distinct tones and does not generalize to overlapping speech/noise. No per-file normalization, no human listening test. Causal audio retains group delay; steady scoring omits fade/startup and truncated end tails.

parameters.physical_playback: uniform noise in [-0.18,0.18] plus 310 Hz sine amplitude 0.08, continuously present during reference loss
parameters.fade: squared sine from 0 to pi/2, endpoint included; reverse at end
parameters.microphone_model: known causal FIR echo plus synthetic near-end harmonic target; no noise or measured room
parameters.algorithm: NLMSState prior residual, oracle initial weights equal true path; frozen on all samples
parameters.interval_convention: half-open; missing algorithm reference is replaced with zeros, physical playback is unchanged
parameters.alignment: same sample origin, zero algorithm delay; no fitted gain or delay
parameters.metric: sum((output-target)^2)/sum(target^2), using each declared interval; not ERLE, SNR or intelligibility
parameters.statistics: one fixed-seed mathematical fixture, no repeated-trial or listening study

aec_dropout.limits: Four mono files share export gain 1. Ideal path knowledge excludes identification error. Missing reference contaminates delayed taps for 240 more samples after transport resumes. Float analytic checks and PCM-to-PCM scores are separate; no third-party recording.

parameters.model: instantaneous real linear mixtures; no geometric propagation delay
parameters.oracle_gate: update only n<8000; known time labels, not estimated SPP/VAD
parameters.alignment: same sample origin; no gain fitting, delay alignment or fitted rescaling
parameters.statistics: deterministic tones and updates, no random trials or listening scores

gsc_gate.limits: Original mathematical mixture, not a free-field array or real recording. Freezing prevents further target adaptation but retains a 0.92 target response. The target-only score is reference error, not SNR, denoising quality or speech intelligibility.

parameters.broadband_model: 365 equal-amplitude periodic multisine bins; independent seeded phases
parameters.rng: NumPy default_rng PCG64, uniform phase [-pi, pi)
parameters.fade: squared sine, endpoint included, before channel delay
parameters.delay_boundary: causal zero extension, output truncated to 32000 samples
parameters.score_window: rectangular, one complete steady multisine period
parameters.randomness: fixed source phases only; no repeated-trial statistics

doa_ambiguity.limits: Mathematical equal-amplitude far-field model, no measured recording or speech. The 2 kHz steady tone has equal phase at delays +2 and -6 samples within the physical bound. Finite fades and record boundaries can break a full-record GCC tie; this does not make a steady pure tone globally identifiable. The wide-band signal is a 365-line periodic multisine, not continuous white noise. Scores use only specified bins in the steady 1024-sample segment; PCM quantization is checked separately. No additive noise, SNR improvement or formal listening result is reported.

parameters.source_model: two separate-time finite sinusoidal bursts evaluated at continuous delayed times; no random input
parameters.unaligned_output_model: none; every output uses the same tau delay before rear-channel subtraction
parameters.corrected_output_model: x1(t)-x2(t-tau)/1.01, using known gain, no fitted calibration
parameters.reference: F(t-b)-F(t-b-2*tau), ideal target-only differential output; includes its physical/filter phase
parameters.delay_implementation: continuous source evaluation at shifted time; no interpolation or causal digital filter is executed
parameters.alignment: same time origin and differential response; no post-hoc delay or gain fitting
parameters.normalization: one common export gain across array, target, mismatch and corrected waveforms

dma_calibration.limits: Mathematical free-field equal-amplitude signals, not real speech, a measured DMA or a hardware calibrator. Known 1.01 gain correction and ideal continuous delays demonstrate the null model; no gain or delay estimator is run. A zero rear response is an ideal-model result; PCM16 has a quantization floor. There is no additive noise, so the reported amplitude ratios are not SNR gains. No formal listening study.

parameters.source: 0.08 times seeded unit-variance Gaussian samples with 10 ms linear edge fades; zero elsewhere
parameters.tail_model: z[n]*exp(-3*ln(10)*n/(fs*nominal_T60)), then normalize its total squared sum to 10^(-DRR/10)
parameters.shared_randomness: the same tail Gaussian vector is used in all three conditions; conditions are not independent trials
parameters.reference: room_decay_dry is the common source delayed by 192 samples (12 ms), matching every direct arrival
parameters.alignment: known direct-path alignment; no fitted gain, delay or algorithm estimate
parameters.convolution: zero-padded full FFT linear convolution; full nonzero tail fits in the 40000 retained samples
parameters.energy_units: sum of squared dimensionless digital samples, before common export gain and PCM16 quantization
parameters.edc: reverse sum of squared RIR entries, normalized by that filter total; first remaining-energy ratio <= 1e-6

room_decay.limits: Seeded mathematical scalar filters, not physical room simulation, measured RIR, speech, T20/T30 fit or standard reverberation-time measurement. Nominal T60 controls the amplitude envelope; total-EDC threshold times also depend on DRR, onset, finite tail and this random draw. RIR component energy ratios do not equal finite convolved-signal ratios; the outputs contain direct/tail cross terms. No noise-removal algorithm or listening study is evaluated.

parameters.source: sum of 1000 and 4000 Hz sinusoids with 20 ms linear edge fades
parameters.initial_history: zero; causal delay, no circular wrap
parameters.reference: clean target delayed by one sample; identical to aligned output
parameters.alignment: known one-sample delay added to channel 1; no estimated direction or delay
parameters.comparison: Compare projected tone amplitudes. Do not interpret raw time-domain error across unequal delays as amplitude loss.

alignment_error.limits: Target-only mathematical example; no noise, HRTF, room, speech or device recording. Level changes are not SNR gains; known alignment is not an estimated algorithm result.

parameters.source: 500 and 6000 Hz continuous sinusoids, each amplitude 0.18; 20 ms linear edge fades
parameters.initial_history: zero; source is zero outside [0, 2] seconds
parameters.reference: Compare each output to its matching ideal delay; no gain fitting or time alignment
parameters.normalization: one common export gain for all four files

interpolation.limits: Mathematical fixed-delay component example, not a resampling-rate estimator, room, device or speech quality test. Two passes delay by one sample but are not an exact one-sample delay.

parameters.source: sum of two continuous sinusoids with 20 ms linear edge fades
parameters.sampling_times: t1=n/fs, t2=n/(fs*(1+100e-6)); n starts at zero
parameters.export_time_axis: Both sample sequences stored at nominal 16000 Hz; fast channel is intentionally not time-corrected
parameters.oracle: Analytically evaluate both sensors at t1; no estimated clock, interpolation or resampling algorithm
parameters.geometry: co-located omnidirectional ideal sensors; zero propagation difference
parameters.alignment: same physical start; no post-hoc delay or gain fitting

clock_drift.limits: Mathematical clock-only counterexample, no noise, room, speech or device data. Oracle is the ideal common-clock target, not measured compensation performance.

parameters.reference: target delayed by 3 samples; ignore first 3 samples when scoring
parameters.alignment: delay mic2 by 3, no noncausal advance

spatial.limits: Integer-delay broadband model; not binaural HRTF, measured array or speech.

parameters.source: 383 Hz six-harmonic tone plus seeded broadband noise, std 0.04
parameters.fractional_delay_model: linear interpolation with zero outside the 2 s source
parameters.reference: clean microphone 1 at its physical arrival time; no gain or delay fitting
parameters.alignment: causally delay microphones 2--4 to microphone 1 using linear interpolation

fractional_array.limits: Far-field plane wave with simulated fractional delays and independent sensor noise; no measured room, microphone directivity or physical moving-source recording.

aec.limits: Exactly matched linear path, known double-talk mask (not an implemented DTD); no real-room ERLE claim.

parameters.reference: seeded white Gaussian std 0.12 plus 310 Hz sine amplitude 0.09
parameters.microphone_model: causal 4-tap FIR, path selected per output sample, plus independent Gaussian background noise std 0.005; no near end
parameters.output: causal prior linear residual before each sample update

aec_methods.limits: Seeded mathematical signal and exactly known 4-tap path; single run, no near end, DTD, real loudspeaker, room or subjective speech test. Do not rank industrial AEC from these WAVs.

parameters.reference: seeded Gaussian std 0.12 plus 2100 Hz sine amplitude 0.08
parameters.model: known current/previous block 2x2 crossband matrices; diagonal_model removes exact off-diagonal terms

aec_subband.limits: Known-path system representation only; diagonal model has NOT been adapted or fitted. The difference is missing cross terms, not a measured AEC residual or subband ERLE.

wpe.limits: Offline WPE may remove predictable harmonic content; this sparse FIR is not a room or speech-quality benchmark.

separation.limits: Known instantaneous mixing matrix; solving it is not blind separation, ICA or neural inference.

engineering.limits: Clipping and dropout are deliberate faults, not enhancement algorithms.

tracking.limits: Equal-power stereo panning; not a physical moving-source array recording and not valid DOA ground truth.

parameters.model: Both target channels are already aligned; average weights [0.5, 0.5].
parameters.reference: correlation_reference, no delay; score all samples

correlation.limits: Population variances predict 3.0103 dB and 0 dB; one finite realization is not a statistical performance estimate.

parameters.reference: polarity_reference, no delay; no gain fitting when scoring

polarity.limits: Known polarity correction, not blind calibration. Array WAV is raw stereo; compare mono averages to study cancellation.

parameters.reference: conditioning_reference; compare each source channel without delay or gain fitting

conditioning.limits: Both mixing matrices are known; this is inverse-problem noise amplification, not blind separation or a benchmark of AuxIVA.

parameters.model: d=x+2*x**3; best whole-segment scalar least-squares fit g*x
parameters.reference: nonlinear_echo for echo-power ratio; nonlinear_reference is playback

nonlinear.limits: Steady sinusoid, memoryless cubic distortion and batch scalar projection; not NLMS convergence, a measured loudspeaker or speech-quality evaluation.

parameters.clean_model: 173 Hz six-harmonic synthetic tone, silent for first 0.4 s, 20 ms squared-sine onset
parameters.noise_estimation: per-bin arithmetic mean of |Y|^2 over complete noise-only frames
parameters.algorithm_delay_samples: offline STFT demonstration; no online latency claim
parameters.reference: spectral_clean; no delay or gain fitting; first 0.4 s is noise-only

spectral_subtraction.limits: Single seeded mathematical tone plus stationary Gaussian noise; fixed oracle-marked noise-only preamble. The zero-floor output may make sparse tonal residuals audible; no human listening study, natural speech, VAD, adaptive noise tracker, MMSE-STSA or MMSE-LSA.

parameters.source: ten isolated one-sample mathematical impulses, separated by six 512-sample blocks
parameters.linear_method: 512-sample input blocks, 632-point real FFT and inverse; add full overlapping tails; truncate at 32000 samples for WAV
parameters.wrong_method: each 512-sample input block circularly convolves with the 512-point padded FIR; no history and no overlap-add
parameters.pcm: 16-bit signed little endian, nearest-even, no dither
parameters.alignment: same sample origin; no time shift, delay or per-file gain matching
parameters.reference: math_block_dry is the common excitation; math_block_linear is the correct causal FIR output
parameters.tail: last nonzero pulse and echo both lie before sample 32000; full linear output beyond the record is zero

math_block.limits: Mathematical impulse and FIR example, not speech, room, echo-canceller or hardware recording. The premature response is an intentional faulty block implementation. Impulse clicks may sound different, but no human listening experiment was performed.
